questions.q: What does ELAC stand for?
questions.a: Elevator Aileron Computer

questions.q: How many ELAC’s on the Airbus? And what do they control?
questions.a: 2 ELAC’s they control elevator, aileron and stabilizer.

questions.q: What are the functions of the ELAC?
questions.a: Normal pitch, Alternate pitch, direct pitch. Normal roll, direct roll Abnormal attitude Aileron droop Acquisition of autopilot orders

questions.q: Under Normal Law, what does ELAC 1 control?
questions.a: Primary - Aileron control (roll) Standby - Elevator / Stabilizer control (backs up ELAC 2) Provides 5° aileron droop

questions.q: Under Normal Law, what does ELAC 2 control?
questions.a: Primary - Elevator / Stabilizer (pitch) Standby - Aileron control (backs up ELAC 1)

questions.q: What functions are performed by the SEC’s?
questions.a: Normal roll, Direct roll (by controlling the spoilers). Alternate pitch, Direct pitch (SEC 1 & 2 only) Speed brakes and ground spoilers (SEC 1 & 3 only). Abnormal attitude.

questions.q: Under Normal Law, what do the 3 SEC’s control?
questions.a: Primary – Spoiler control (roll) Standby – Elevator / Stabilizer control (SEC 1 & 2 back up the ELAC’s)

questions.q: What is the sole purpose of SEC 3?
questions.a: SEC3 spoiler 1/2 Spoiler control All 3 SEC's Spoiler control

questions.q: Under Normal Law, what functions do the FAC’s provide (FLY-W)?

questions.q: How are the flight control surfaces controlled and actuated?

questions.q: When is the automatic pitch trim available?
